checks: Fresh 1x5-star/3x4-star grant; invalid, insufficient and unowned requests preserve all progress.
Both coupons normalize input, grant the exact amounts and reject reuse without changes.
Ten pulls charge once and persist ownership, pity, guarantee, currency, coupon use and random stream across restart.
A real save-path failure rolls back draw/RNG/pity/currency and synchronization/materials, restores battle growth and returns no result.
The 80th guaranteed five-star honors the newly selected banner and persists the acquired/edited party.
The actual campaign uses the saved owned party; inventory changes are rejected during an active expedition.
